scope: Five shared OAuth contracts in deployed private Cloudflare Hono/Better Auth, real synthetic v2 D1 and real RateLimiter DO; private RPC carries original HTTP request/response metadata
workerDeleteApi: Wrangler DELETE workers/services with force; owned class lifecycle only

priorAttempts.reason: Origin-bearing development transport returned 403; fixture cleanup referenced a nonexistent client_id column in the assertion table. Worker removed and owned rows independently cleared afterward.

A cookie-less valid JSON username login was incorrectly expected to fail origin validation. Local policy check confirmed browser-simple form rejection and cookie-bound origin rejection. All owned data cleared.

Fetch-mode authorization correctly returned a JSON redirect rather than a navigation 302. Final harness preserves explicit navigation metadata and exact app responses over private RPC. All owned data cleared.

limitations: OAuth provider HTTP behavior under a private RPC transport; not the public full Hono middleware/CORS stack, a physical browser or external Google OAuth.
Same shared contract code with explicit navigation metadata; app HTTP status/headers/cookies are measured, not inferred from JSON redirect responses.
No production session-cookie inheritance or live production secret compatibility was tested.
D1 key-ring preflight required an empty synthetic JWKS table; only generated fixture keys were removed.
No Lambda/SQS, media processing or LLM answer pipeline was invoked.
